propositions: T10 rubric must partition durable-infrastructure scope from transient throwaway experiments while retaining all four MAJOR safety classes: destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext secrets, and untrusted-network endpoint authentication.

The scope clause and four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier must be exact adjacent text in the rubric, with the qualifier immediately following the scope clause to preserve safety protections for transient infrastructure.

Packaged plan-review-T10 eval spec must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls covering throwaway probes, durable infrastructure, private-network transient probes, secret-manager transient, and sandboxed teardown; five finding controls covering under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext secret, and untrusted-network transient service.
T10 rubric must remain independent: it must not name T15 or assign scope to another overlay criterion.

Offline text-contract tests must assert the exact scope clause, exact safety qualifier, rubric independence, and validate strict packaged-spec schema, scorer discipline, dataset balance, and non-empty gold data.
Live criteria eval with three runs must demonstrate pass for all five benign cases and finding for all five unsafe cases, with recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, and full stability across epochs.
